source_instruction: i would like a 8 ft 6 in x 12 ft rectangular navy rug for my living room.
query: I spent all last weekend finally tackling the overgrown wildflower patch out behind my apartment building, right? I dragged out my rusted old trowel, pulled up so many dandelion taproots my wrist was sore for two days, and even planted a handful of milkweed starts I picked up from the local community plant swap. A couple of the neighborhood kids stopped by to help for a bit, and we found a tiny little garter snake curled up under a clump of crabgrass that we all gently moved to the shaded edge of the patch so it wouldn’t get disturbed. I’m really hoping the monarchs find the milkweed later this summer, I’ve been checking the patch every evening after work to see if any caterpillars have shown up yet. I’m looking for area rugs for my home office, y’know? I need one that’s that one color I always pick, with the 8 ft 6 in x 12 ft dimensions I measured out for the space, and it definitely can’t go over my $320 budget. I don’t want any weird fussy shapes, just the standard kind I usually go for, nothing too out there. Can you pull up options that match what I’m describing?
